text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Yeah, what a sense of accomplishment☆
I showed off my best in front of such a huge crowd!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: A style of running guided by feng shui that only I can do!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, so that's Copano Rickey.
The Umamusume who runs on feng shui..."

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Just watching her gets your heart racing, doesn't it?
Like she's about to make something incredible happen!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I wasn't really interested before,
but maybe I'll follow it a little.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you☆
With this, we connected the dragon vein of popularity from the Japan Derby to the dirt track!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: And there was one more thing to be grateful for!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: If I hadn't met Trainer, I might not have even been able to run in the Nippon Derby.
choice_data_list: Do you mean in terms of results?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"No, in terms of feng shui.
I haven't told you about this yet, but..."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
A while ago, I checked my compatibility with the Japan Derby,
and it turned out to be really bad.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Before the race—there was a chance something could have
happened to keep me from running.
Blocked by some twist of fate, you know?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it seems a small ripple formed in the area,
and that brought about a change.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Thanks♪ For bringing it to a point
where I can handle the rest!

"To be honest, I didn't completely understand the meaning.
Still, it seemed certain that I had been of help to Copano Rickey."
And a few days after the Japanese Derby—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Trainer!
Look, look at that shop over there!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Look at all those people at the feng shui shop!
I've never seen it this crowded before~

text_block_list.name: High School Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, aren't stones like this
so pretty and nice?
Apparently, getting your lucky color is the way to go.

text_block_list.name: High School Girl B
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe I'll go buy a book.
I want to find out what kind of things I should put by my pillow."

The shop was bustling with crowds of customers.
There were even massive banners set up—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That banner says... let's see—
'Trending now thanks to Copano Rickey!
The miraculous power of Feng Shui!'

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... I'm glad it got people talking, but
'Miraculous Feng Shui Power!'
is laying it on a bit thick, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Personally, I would've preferred a more relaxed vibe, like... if you make the right feng shui preparations, your luck will naturally improve.

"There's definitely quite a bit of exaggeration in it.
Still, it was way better than being ignored."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I guess this is the Japanese Derby effect.
The amount of attention on us is completely on another level compared to usual☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If only this gets everyone to take
even a little interest in feng shui!
A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Trainer, look, look! At this letter☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "Look at this: 'I tried Rickey's Feng Shui, and it made me feel a lot more positive! I'm totally a huge fan now♪'!"
choice_data_list: Oh, I'm glad to hear that!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I can feel it~ That the feng shui is steadily...
passing on our wish for happiness.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, keep it up! The season moves from
Lesser Fullness to Grain in Ear. And then into fruitful summer♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Spread far and wide, my feng shui☆

—Using the major race, the Japanese Derby, as an opportunity
to draw the interest of many different people.
That prediction seemed to hit the mark dead on.
